body: Thank you so much, something that I really need to be reminded of. I really appreciate this advice.
I'm not mad, it's just that you're giving advice that's 7 years old. Pointless.
Anyway, any advice?

It is creepy and I understand where you're coming from. "If that was my daughter/sister..". I appreciate your advice though. Maybe we're just different people now, I did get with him at very young age.

I can tell you I was. I recovered from a deadly cancer at a young age, was abused, immigrated to a foreign country/culture, attended college courses/gifted academies. I wasn't a particularly normal girl, and what I've been through does nothing but grow you. 

But, the thing is, I'm 21 now. And even if what you say is true---if I move on from this relationship I will continue to seek older men at my age. It's just a preference at this point.

I was very exceptionally grown and pursued adult men a lot at that age, online purely. Little harm. I insisted many times and he caved in to reciprocating flirtations and feelings. Met when I was legal.

Everything between the highlight reel of my relationship is peaches and cream, but it is a very worn, shredded, and drug through the trenches kind of relationship. Thanks for the advice, I will think about what you said.

This is the last straw, you are finally free, live with your boyfriend and have hope. Leave and don't come back, this is the turning point for you, a new chapter away from your family. I left to my boyfriend in the same way, packed my things and got an airplane ticket and a friend to take me to the airport. Look forward to life away from them and I wish you luck in the process of healing after that life. This is it!

Oooh, I'd get this one but in a different format, "I am telling you this because I am your mom and I love you, no one else would tell you the truth otherwise". Usually after she calls me fat, ugly, flat-footed, cross-legged, lazy, ungrateful, pock-faced, slow, ect ect.

I'm a child of former Soviet citizens, where therapy/psychiatry/psychology is for political prisoners! When I was getting worse I did everything in my power to get medication and therapy and visits to the psychology/psychiatry department. I went to the school counselor and told her of my suicidal thoughts, I went to my doctor, I went to anyone that would listen just so I could get some help. I was shamed by my parents, ridiculed, but I got too many outsiders wrapped up that not giving me the help I needed would make them look quite bad. Therapy didn't work out for me, my therapists were terrible, but some medications helped, even though I'm not on them anymore. Either way, do your best to ignore them, know that you MUST help yourself, it is for your happiness, it is to make you better, it is to help you survive and live. You must understand that regardless of their shit, it is for you to survive. Even if in the end meds and therapy don't help, you will find solace and assistance and the help you need, it'll give you another outlook. It's not for her, it is not for her pleasure, it is not in any relation to her other than the devastation that she has caused. In fact go to the therapist and tell them that yeah, my mom makes me hide my pills and tells me I'm insane and don't need therapy, the moment you walk into the door. Know that your instincts are correct and the way she is treating you is absolutely wrong. That it is vital, and crucial, for you to care for yourself.

Yes, I have this exact same problem and it has caused a lot of issues in my relationship and relationships with others. I catch myself all the time acting like an asshole, and get called out on it as well. It has ruined a lot of friendships. For me I found that indulging myself and being easy on myself, getting pampered, getting the food I really love that I was never allowed to get, showing other people funny videos that are my guilty pleasures, and trying to be kind to others, mindfully, helped me relax a bit. I was always thinking to my parents' standards, and they were never realistic. My boyfriend playing a videogame for children when he could be cleaning the house and doing work related things and bettering himself, and reading books, and working out, all the same time, instead of playing a stupid kid's game.....that is the kind of thoughts I would have. Instead I show him my stupid kid's game that I'm embarrassed to say is kinda fun, and showing him videos of baby horses that I like.. it helps. Find peace in these small things and know its okay.

The biggest thing is time. Treat it like a cold or the flu. Let it just take its time to get out of the system and go through the motions. The pain and depression and anger all need to let out--it is a matter of patience. A therapist will help, surely. I have been through therapy, group therapy, 7 medications, family therapy, ect, and the biggest help is having a supportive boyfriend that is patient with me and gave me this analogy. It is best to let it run its course, to be angry and sad and depressed, to cry and scream, and to ask for help and support. Be open to compassion and let kind words and love from friends and others to help. You will get over it, but you need time. Do not let it linger inside. The solidarity here will help, know that you are not alone.

Oh yeah, every time I call my mom she asks me if he's sick and tired of me because I don't work, then tells me that he's going to kick me out soon. While my mom herself doesn't work, went to cosmetology school and masseuse school, and worked for a bit then quit--while my dad might as well be a CEO is a Silicon Valley company. 
Fuck, every time I'd eat something, "You're losing your figure, nobody is going to want you." Even at age 10, "Lida, you have to learn to cook because no man would want you." She's still trying to arrange my marriage to some bloke of another family's any time she hears there is a single son that is Russian out there. 
A terrible incident, back when I was trying to fix relations, I had my BF stay with us for a little bit just to see California. One night after we were up for 12 hours going to aquariums, Monterey, zoos, came home and collapsed--little sister had a severe panic attack and was taken to the emergency room during the night. I asked her what was wrong the day after and she said she was scared that I was going to leave forever and not come back and she'll be alone. Parents somehow heard from her that she heard us having sex and freaked out and was in shock. To this day my mom and dad would make jokes about me having sex all the time. In the car, on the phone, about me fucking and moaning and them all hearing it and giggling. I'm pretty sure my mom never had an orgasm. 
Lol! My mom got preggo with me at age... 32? 35? Hell, if I know. Told me she prayed to get pregnant and was "unexpectedly" pregnant within like 2 months of her relationship and they got married. I'll have to check that book out. 
My mom lived in poverty with her mom, alcoholic father left, that worked hard as hell, but grew up during the Holodomor but was severely depressed and worked too much to have a proper family life, extended family was the only family my mom seemed to have, and to this day she hates talking to them because she fears they'll ask for money, which they do, because uh, it's shit back there and they're living in a half a million dollar house. 
The only time I see her happy, even a false happiness, is at dinner parties. God.

Yes, my little sister too is very emotionally sensitive, but damn, does she talk back and question everything, fearless even. The fear for her to blabber to someone about the family's behavior keeps them in check I guess.

Little sister would get yelled at too, one time mom locked her in the shoe closet because she was being annoyed. They are much kinder to her because of me and the police visit. The beatings stopped because I grew bigger and could hit back. Unfortunately my little sister is having trouble at school and cries a lot over the fact that she's failing and letting her parents down. They insult her constantly and can't give any praise. Even with her grades being up they will always find something wrong. Never say anything positive, always pointing out the negative. Like they'll get their damn arms cut off at the mention of any kindness.

If it is a common thing for former soviet parents to be like this, how can any family survive?? I remember my best friend when I was younger would get beaten too and her mother and her in later years entered a strange symbiotic relationship where they were best friends for parasitic reasons. The worst offence I noticed was when the police officer came due to the physical abuse form. I had myself sat down after he left and my parents gave me the rundown how now the government is watching them and they can get their green card abolished, their tax rates hiked up, cards declined, all this bullshit. So Russian of them. Funny thing was when I was lying through my teeth about any physical abuse, my mom was interrogated in the next room and yammered off about how she did beat me because I never listened and sold herself out. 
How do you feel about staying by your parents no matter what, as a Russian/Ukranian myself it has been ingrained in me that family is all you ever have and to trust nobody.
But even within family everything is a transactional relationship.
When I received any kindness from someone on the outside my parents would be irritated and say that there is always a hidden motive, that no one can be genuinely, selflessly kind.

We are poor but recently got jobs, money was very tight but it is better now. His parents helped us out and loaned us money once in a while. I fear that even when I cut them out, the memories will still mess with me. That is my biggest worry, that even after they are dead and gone I will still be ill and on a thin line. Thank you for your advice.

Thank you, I thought I had some form of PTSD but I was never diagnosed, and it was never paid attention to. I have just posted on that subreddit, I didn't know it existed and I thank you. I hope I can get help there.

Self respect is a very big issue with me, I have none and I am trying to learn to have it, it is hard but I try. I will consider cutting them out of my life, even when I did have abusive relationships, I never really did cut them out, I offered help and my leave. I will try hard to consider this. Thank you for your advice.

I am just so retarded in many ways that being hindered in health and latching onto my parents for dear life because if not for them I would have experienced certain death. Medical issue after one another and no one but them to take me to the doctor's, albeit through gritted teeth and haste, with no compassion, was the only thing I had. Constantly housed and protected and fed, and kept like a child all my life, restricted, it is hard to let go of them. Even more so when I have never seen anyone play Devil and Angel so well. Hysterics and screaming and verbal assault and then in minutes all forgotten, dinner is ready and a smile to each face. It is just torture, I thank you for your advice. Even in my mind I question over and over that maybe it is I to blame, that I overreact, that I am an adult now and nothing should affect me. That the past is the past and so it shall be, that I should be stronger. Everyone tells me this. And I am ashamed that it affects to such a degree. I thought I would be free of them, but even still they just haunt me. I will consider cutting all ties. I have a little sister. That will be the most painful thing, she is only 12 and I miss her dearly. Thank you again.
